spans.s:
mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Insane, frantic, mad.
2 Drunk, intoxicated.
m. (-त्तः)
1 The thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.)
2 A plant, (Pterospermum acerifolium.)
E.
उत् much, मत्त drunk or mad: applied to the plants, it alludes to their deleterious properties.

f. (-त्ता)
Insanity, intoxication.
E.
तल् added to the last; also उन्मत्तत्वं.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Mad, furious, extravagant, intoxicated.
m. (-दः)
Insanity, either morbid or as the effect or temporary excitement, intoxication, ecstasy^1.
E.
उत् very, मद to be mad, अच् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Mad, insane, extravagant.
m. (-दः)
1 Madness, extravagance.
2 (In medicine,) Mania.
E.
उद् much, मद to be mad, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Mad, insane, crazed.
2

Intoxicated.
3

In rut, (as an elephant.)
E.
उन्मद to be mad, इष्णुच् attributive. aff.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Regretting, missing, sorrowing for a lost or departed friend, &c.
E.
उत् up, upset, disturbed, and मनस् the mind.

m. (-न्थः)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2 Agitation.
E.
उत् before, मथि to kill, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What moves or stirs.
2 Throbbing, beating.
m. (-कः)
Inflammation of the outer ear.
E.
उद् before मथि to hurt, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Shaking, agitating.
2 Hurting, killing.
3 Probing, stirring a weapon, &c. lodged in the body.
E.
उद् before मथि to hurt, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Moved, agitated, distressed.
E.
उद् and मन्थित agitated.

m. (-थः)
1 A snare or trap.
2 Killing, slaughter.
2 A killer, a slaughterer.
4 Pride, disdain.
E.
उत्, मथ to agitate, and घञ् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 Maddening, exciting, intoxicating.
2 One of five arrows borne by KĀMADEVA, the Hindu CUPID.
E.
उत् before मद to be mad or intoxicated, causal form, ल्यट् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Mad, insane, wild, extravagant.
E.
उन्माद madness, &c. and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Mad, intoxicated.
E.
उन्माद and इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
A measure of size or quantity.
E.
उद् and मा to measure, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्गः)
1 A wrong road.
2 Improper conduct, an evil course, error.
E.
उद् and मार्ग way.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Erred, erring, going wrong.
E.
उन्मार्ग and गत gone.

n. (-नं)
1 Going a wrong road.
2 Following evil courses.
E.
उन्मार्ग and गमन going.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Going wrong, erring, following evil courses.
2 Taking a wrong road.
E.
उन्मार्ग and गामिन् who goes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Meted, measured.
E.
उद् before मा to measure, क्त aff.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Opening the eye, drawing up the eyelid, looking at, seeing.
E.
उद् before मिष to scatter, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Opened, (as the eye.)
2 Blown as a flower.
E.
उद् up, मिष to scatter, affix क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Winking, twinkling of the eye.
2 Blowing, expanding.
E.
उद् and मील to twinkle, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Opened, (as the eyes.)
2 Blown as a flower.
E.
उद्, मील to wink, affix क्त.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Looking upwards.
E.
उद् up, मुख the face.

mfn. (द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
1 Blown as a flower.
2 Unsealed, opened.
E.
उद् up, open, and मुद्रा a seal.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eradicated, pulled up by the roots.
E.
उद् up, मूल nominal verb, to take root, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Worn off, blotted out.
E.
उद् out, मृष्ट rubbed.

f. (-दा)
Corpulency, fatness.
E.
उद् much, मिद to anoint, अच् and टाप् affs.

m. (-षः)
1 Winking, twinkling of the eyelids, the upward motion.
2 Opening the eye, looking at.
E.
उद् up, मिष to scatter, affix घञ्.
